<thought>Only chlorine shows a clear, characteristic M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, matching its natural 35Cl/37Cl isotopic ratio (≈3:1). No other element exhibits a distinctive pattern strong enough to be identified definitively from the given spectrum. Therefore, chlorine is the sole element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
